title: A long cloud session picks up hook changes from main, not only the copy it installed at start
why: A stale guard copy lets mistakes through that main's guard refuses.
note: Coordinator 13:00 CST Nov 11: a long cloud session runs the hooks it installed at start. The coordinator ran a guard copy older than 10e38b0ae (lane start: effort field and brief as prompt) until 12:50 CST today, so 7 lane starts sent a bare "/effort medium" prompt and the lane-effort-pin guard never saw them (retrospective brief audit, 12:56 CST). The guard that would have stopped it is lane-effort-pin, which was not loaded. Owner 12:59 CST (relayed by the retrospective): "its weird a lane can be spawned without its brief first preprovided like somesthings going wrong if the lane/session just autospawns and then gets filled in after the fact, feels weird". Plan 691a84e places this as stage 3 item 3.10. Owner 13:21 CST Nov 11 (relayed by the retrospective, plan 3.10 at 707853e): "yes sorry i meant reinstall not restart i agree". When hooks or settings on main changed since the install, a session reinstalls at its next turn, in place; it restarts only for a change a reinstall cannot load (a lane measures that first). Coordinator 13:57 CST Nov 11: the session-start installer reuses /root/claude-settings-main (ddaa393c0, 17:50 CST Nov 9) because it thinks that clone has local commits main lacks, so a resume reinstalls the stale copy. The stale lane-effort-pin refused the 3.0 lane start at 13:59 CST; the coordinator reinstalled from main 6745ade70 with merge/install_from_main.sh (exit 0) under the owner's 13:21 ruling. Triage 14:08 CST Nov 11: install_from_main.sh installs the local branch main with no check against origin/main. This clone's main sat 5727 commits behind (da8d8073c, Nov 2), so the first run at 14:08 installed that old copy, exit 0. After the main fast-forward, the second run at 14:10 installed 6745ade70. Guard owed: the script refuses, or fast-forwards, when local main is behind origin/main and has no local commits. Coordinator 14:18 CST Nov 11, measured: a session resume re-runs the start-up installer. That run installs from the mirror /root/claude-settings-main (ddaa393c0, Nov 9), and skips the refresh because the mirror's local main has local commits main lacks. It reverted the coordinator's 13:56 reinstall at the 14:16 resume. Check after each resume: grep -c "slash command runs only" ~/.claude/hooks/guard.py; a count above 0 means the stale copy is back, so reinstall. git fetch moves origin/main only, never local main, and the installer reads local main. Retrospective 14:18 CST Nov 11 (a finding, not a ruling): install.sh's source search can pick a clone in a scratchpad. The retrospective's /root/.claude/CLAUDE.md now imports from its scratchpad clone, which can vanish under the session. Fix: the source search skips scratchpad and temp folders, and the mechanized reinstall clones to a fixed path. Owner 14:19 CST Nov 11, in the coordinator's chat: "can we just fix the installer to fetch and use main? kinda confused here as to how that local branch is forced to stay". Root cause, measured by the coordinator: install.sh mirror_refresh keeps the mirror when main != config claude-settings.mirrorSha (88266e827, while main is ddaa393c0; both are on origin/main). A fast-forward merge never updates mirrorSha, so it reads as local commits forever. Lane mirror-refresh-ancestor started 14:21 CST: refresh unless main holds a commit the fetched ref lacks; install_from_main.sh fetches and uses origin's main; both print the installed commit. Part landed: lane mirror-refresh-ancestor, PR #2601, merged in batch 88 (f024eae4e, 23:50 CST Nov 11): install.sh refreshes the mirror by ancestry, and install_from_main.sh fetches origin main. Still open: the source search skipping scratchpad and temp folders (install.sh at f024eae4e names neither), and the reinstall cloning to a fixed path. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was mirror-refresh-ancestor ([ended:mirror-refresh-ancestor])). Lane cloud-hooks-stale-copy started 11:10 CST Nov 12 (coordinator 11:10 CST). Triage read 11:13 CST: this session's install source /home/user/claude-settings is at 2deb827ad (main, batch 103), installed 16:40Z (10:40 CST), so it is current; no re-run needed.
